00069 void EnvGenUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {
00071   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00072   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073   
00074   if(isStealing() == false && shouldSteal() == true)
00075   {
00076     setIsStealing();
00077     const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00078     float stealValue = (float)currentValue;
00079     float targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00080     float inc = (targetValue - stealValue) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00081     while(numSamplesToProcess)
00082     {
00083       *outputSamples++ = stealValue;
00084       stealValue += inc;
00085       --numSamplesToProcess;
00086     }
00087     shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00088     currentValue = targetValue;
00089     currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00090     setIsDone();
00091   }
00092   else
00093   {
00094     if(isReleasing() == false && shouldRelease() == true)
00095     {
00096       int releaseNode = env_.getReleaseNode();
00097 
00098       if(releaseNode >= 0) // try this, - don't release if releaseNode is -1
00099       {
00100         setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate());
00101       }
00102     }   
00103     
00104     while(numSamplesToProcess && isDone() == false)
00105     {
00106       int samplesThisTime = min(stepsUntilTarget, numSamplesToProcess);
00107       numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00108       stepsUntilTarget -= samplesThisTime;
00109       
00110       // select from different curves here..., use a different loop
00111       
00112       switch(currentCurve.getType())
00113       {
00114         case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00115           while(samplesThisTime)
00116           {
00117             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00118             b1 *= grow;
00119             currentValue = a2 - b1;
00120             --samplesThisTime;
00121           }
00122           break;
00123         case EnvCurve::Linear:
00124           while(samplesThisTime)
00125           {
00126             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00127             currentValue += grow;
00128             --samplesThisTime;
00129           }
00130           break;
00131         case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00132           while(samplesThisTime)
00133           {
00134             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00135             currentValue *= grow;
00136             --samplesThisTime;
00137           }
00138           break;
00139         case EnvCurve::Sine:
00140           while(samplesThisTime)
00141           {
00142             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00143             double y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00144             currentValue = a2 - y0;
00145             y2 = y1; 
00146             y1 = y0;
00147             --samplesThisTime;
00148           }
00149           break;
00150         case EnvCurve::Welch:
00151           while(samplesThisTime)
00152           {
00153             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00154             double y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00155             currentValue = a2 + y0;
00156             y2 = y1; 
00157             y1 = y0;
00158             --samplesThisTime;
00159           }
00160           break;
00161         case EnvCurve::Empty:
00162         case EnvCurve::Step:
00163         default:
00164           while(samplesThisTime)
00165           {
00166             *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00167             --samplesThisTime;
00168           }
00169       }
00170       
00171       if(stepsUntilTarget <= 0)
00172       {
00173         if(setSegment(currentSegment + 1, UGen::getSampleRate()) == true)
00174         {
00175           shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00176           const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00177           currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00178           currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00179           goto exit;
00180         }
00181       }
00182     }
00183   }
00184     
00185   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00186   {
00187     *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00188   }
00189     
00190   return;
00191   
00192 exit:
00193   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00194   {
00195     *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00196   }
00197   setIsDone();
00198 }

00211 bool EnvGenUGenInternal::setSegment(const int segment, const double stepsPerSecond) throw()
00212 { 
00213   ugen_assert(stepsPerSecond > 0.0);
00214   
00215   if(segment == env_.getReleaseNode())
00216   { 
00217     if(shouldRelease() == true)
00218     {
00219       currentSegment = segment;
00220       setIsReleasing();
00221     } 
00222     else
00223     {
00224       const int loopNode = env_.getLoopNode();
00225       if(loopNode < 0)
00226       {
00227         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00228         stepsUntilTarget = 0x7FFFFFFF; // very large !
00229         return false;
00230       }
00231       else
00232       {
00233         currentSegment = loopNode;
00234         currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment);
00235       }
00236     }
00237   }
00238   else
00239   {
00240     currentSegment = segment;
00241   }
00242   
00243   const int numSegments = env_.getTimes().size();
00244   if(currentSegment >= numSegments) 
00245   { 
00246     return true; // env done
00247   }
00248   
00249   double targetTime = env_.getTimes().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment);
00250   double targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(currentSegment + 1);
00251   
00252   if(currentSegment == (numSegments-1))
00253   {
00254     sendReleasing(targetTime);
00255   } 
00256   
00257   stepsUntilTarget = (int)(stepsPerSecond * targetTime);
00258   if(stepsUntilTarget < 1) 
00259   {
00260     stepsUntilTarget = 1;
00261     currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00262   }
00263   else
00264     currentCurve = env_.getCurves()[currentSegment];
00265   
00266   double w, curveValue;
00267   switch(currentCurve.getType())
00268   {
00269     case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00270       curveValue = currentCurve.getCurve();
00271       if(std::fabs(curveValue) > 0.001)
00272       {
00273         double a1 = (targetValue - currentValue) / (1.0 - std::exp(curveValue));  
00274         a2 = currentValue + a1;
00275         b1 = a1; 
00276         grow = std::exp(curveValue / (double)stepsUntilTarget);
00277         break;
00278       }
00279       else
00280       { 
00281         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00282         // fall through to the next case..
00283       }
00284     case EnvCurve::Linear:
00285       grow = (targetValue - currentValue) / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00286       break;
00287     case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00288       grow = std::pow(targetValue / currentValue, 1.0 / (double)stepsUntilTarget);
00289       break;
00290     case EnvCurve::Sine:
00291       w = pi / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00292       
00293       a2 = (targetValue + currentValue) * 0.5;
00294       b1 = 2.0 * std::cos(w);
00295       y1 = (targetValue - currentValue) * 0.5;
00296       y2 = y1 * std::sin(piOverTwo - w);
00297       currentValue = a2 - y1;
00298       
00299       break;
00300     case EnvCurve::Welch:
00301       w = piOverTwo / (double)stepsUntilTarget;
00302       
00303       b1 = 2.0 * std::cos(w);
00304       
00305       if (targetValue >= currentValue) 
00306       {
00307         a2 = currentValue;
00308         y1 = 0.;
00309         y2 = -std::sin(w) * (targetValue - currentValue);
00310       } 
00311       else 
00312       {
00313         a2 = targetValue;
00314         y1 = currentValue - targetValue;
00315         y2 = std::cos(w) * (currentValue - targetValue);
00316       }
00317       
00318       currentValue = a2 + y1;
00319       
00320       break;
00321     case EnvCurve::Empty:
00322     case EnvCurve::Step:
00323     default:
00324       currentValue = targetValue;
00325   }
00326   
00327   return false; // ready for next segment
00328 }

00458 void EnvGenUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00459 {
00460   const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00461   unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00462   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00463   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00464   
00465   int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00466   
00467   double prevValue = currentValue;
00468   
00469   if(isDone()) goto exit;
00470 
00471   while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00472   {
00473     prevValue = currentValue;
00474     if(numKrSamples == 0)
00475     {
00476       if(isStealing() == false && shouldSteal() == true)
00477       {
00478         setIsStealing();
00479         const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00480         float stealValue = (float)currentValue;
00481         float targetValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00482         float inc = (targetValue - stealValue) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00483         while(numSamplesToProcess)
00484         {
00485           *outputSamples++ = stealValue;
00486           stealValue += inc;
00487           --numSamplesToProcess;
00488         }
00489         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00490         currentValue = targetValue;
00491         currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00492         setIsDone();
00493         return;
00494       }
00495       else
00496       {
00497         if(isReleasing() == false && shouldRelease() == true)
00498         {
00499           int releaseNode = env_.getReleaseNode();
00500 //          if(releaseNode < 0)
00501 //          {
00502 //            releaseNode = env_.getTimes().size() - 1;
00503 //          }
00504 //          
00505 //          setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize);
00506           
00507           if(releaseNode >= 0) // try this..
00508           {
00509             setSegment(releaseNode, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize);
00510           }
00511         }   
00512         
00513         --stepsUntilTarget;
00514                   
00515         double y0;
00516         switch(currentCurve.getType())
00517         {
00518           case EnvCurve::Numerical:
00519             currentValue = a2 - b1;
00520             b1 *= grow;
00521             break;
00522           case EnvCurve::Linear:
00523             currentValue += grow;
00524             break;
00525           case EnvCurve::Exponential:
00526             currentValue *= grow;
00527             break;
00528           case EnvCurve::Sine:
00529             y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00530             currentValue = a2 - y0;
00531             y2 = y1; y1 = y0;
00532             break;
00533           case EnvCurve::Welch:
00534             y0 = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00535             currentValue = a2 + y0;
00536             y2 = y1; y1 = y0;
00537             break;
00538           case EnvCurve::Empty:
00539           case EnvCurve::Step:
00540           default:
00541             ;
00542         }
00543         
00544         if(stepsUntilTarget <= 0)
00545         {
00546           if(setSegment(currentSegment + 1, UGen::getSampleRate() / krBlockSize) == true)
00547           {
00548             shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00549             const int numLevels = env_.getLevels().size();
00550             currentValue = env_.getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(numLevels-1);
00551             currentCurve = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Empty);
00552             goto exit;
00553           }
00554         }
00555         
00556       }
00557     }
00558     
00559     numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00560     blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00561     
00562     if(prevValue == currentValue)
00563     {
00564       while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00565       {
00566         *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00567         --numSamplesToProcess;
00568         --numKrSamples;
00569       }
00570     }
00571     else
00572     {
00573       double valueSlope = (currentValue - prevValue) / (double)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00574       
00575       while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00576       {
00577         *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00578         prevValue += valueSlope;
00579         --numSamplesToProcess;
00580         --numKrSamples;
00581       }
00582     }
00583   }   
00584   
00585   return;
00586 
00587 exit:
00588   
00589   if(prevValue == currentValue)
00590   {
00591     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00592     {
00593       *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00594       --numSamplesToProcess;
00595     }
00596   }
00597   else
00598   {
00599     double valueSlope = (currentValue - prevValue) / (double)numSamplesToProcess;
00600     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00601     {
00602       *outputSamples++ = (float)prevValue;
00603       prevValue += valueSlope;
00604       --numSamplesToProcess;
00605     }
00606   }
00607   
00608   setIsDone();
00609 }
